female.sp: EB-AX2 Graze Ein from Mobile Suit Gundam: Iron-Blooded Orphans. The attached model-kit photographs are authoritative mechanical design references: the front view controls the armor proportions and head, while the rear view controls the backpack and weapon mounts. Preserve the near-black charcoal and dark blue-gray armor palette, exposed cool-gray frame joints, tiny yellow eye-sensor and reactor accents, and the machine's unnaturally tall, narrow-waisted silhouette. Keep both enormous angular wing-like shoulder housings with their sharp stepped upper edges, the long heavy forearms, compact pelvis, very long armored legs, and the distinctive three-pronged claw feet with projecting drill-kick toes. Preserve the small pointed head with TWO short horn-like fins and a single narrow yellow sensor motif, translated into two compact black crown fins and a thin amber brow sensor around a fully visible human face. Keep exactly TWO giant Graze Ein axes total: ONE held low in her RIGHT hand and ONE secured vertically to the LEFT side of the backpack; each axe has a long straight dark handle and a broad hooked silver blade. Preserve the compact central backpack, twin weapon rails and the shoulder-machine-gun housings, but do not duplicate the axes, guns, limbs or armor. The open fitted armor may expose collarbones, narrow waist sides and controlled upper-thigh gaps between plates, without reducing the massive shoulders, forearm armor, long shin armor or claw-foot silhouette. Her human face remains fully visible with exactly two natural amber eyes; no opaque visor, Gundam mask or pilot resemblance. Keep both horn fins, both full shoulder housings, both axes, backpack, claw feet and the entire tall figure inside the vertical frame with generous margins. No text, logos, unit numbers or watermark.
